items.label: Elevated Details with Decorative Button-Accent Pockets
items.value: Matching buttons adorn the front pockets, creating a cohesive and designer-inspired look

items.label: Structured Denim with a Vintage-Inspired Wash

items.label: Flattering A-Line Cut for a Perfect Fit
items.value: Designed with a slightly A-line silhouette that skims over your hips and thighs. This universally flattering cut provides ease of movement, accentuates your waist, and creates a long, lean leg line

items.label: Versatile Styling Essential for Your Wardrobe
items.value: They effortlessly pair with tanks, tees, or blouses, making them your go-to choice for summer outings, casual Fridays, or weekend adventures
